title: Client input pipeline: keyboard/mouse to protocol input messages
description: Turn player input into the protocol's input message at a fixed rate, so the server sim and client prediction have something to consume.
acceptanceCriteria: src/client/input/ tracks keyboard (and mouse where used) state and maps it through a rebindable action map to the flight input axes (thrust, yaw, pitch, roll, up, brake) and actions (dock, undock, fire, lock)

An input pump samples the state at the server tick rate (20 Hz) and sends input messages with a strictly increasing seq over the session socket; nothing is sent while a text field or menu has focus, and all keys release on window blur
The client net layer (src/client/net/) owns the socket: hello, auth with the stored token, join_system, typed message handling via the shared server-message registry, and exposes connection status
Unit tests: key mapping, opposing keys cancel, blur releases, seq monotonic across reconnect, pump cadence with fake timers
Playwright: holding the thrust key causes the server to report a changed own-ship velocity (requires TASK-13); screenshot saved
